# GhBooster SMM Panel

> GhBooster is the premier Social Media Marketing (SMM) Panel providing automated, fast, and affordable growth services for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, Facebook, and Twitter.

## Core Pages & Platform Pillars

- [Home](https://www.ghbooster.com/): Main landing page highlighting GhBooster features, supported platforms, instant 24/7 automated delivery, and pricing overviews.
- [Ghana SMM Panel](https://www.ghbooster.com/smm-panel-ghana.html): Ghana's #1 localized SMM hub with instant MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, and AT Money payments.
- [Instagram SMM Panel](https://www.ghbooster.com/smm-panel-instagram.html): Specialized Instagram boosting hub for organic-looking followers, high-retention likes, reels views, and custom comments.
- [TikTok SMM Panel](https://www.ghbooster.com/smm-panel-tiktok.html): Automated TikTok growth center providing instant FYP views, organic followers, video likes, and shares.
- [YouTube SMM Panel](https://www.ghbooster.com/smm-panel-youtube.html): Monetization & growth suite for YouTube watch time hours, real subscribers, high retention views, and video likes.
- [Telegram SMM Panel](https://www.ghbooster.com/smm-panel-telegram.html): High speed Telegram growth panel for real channel members, group members, post views, and poll votes.
- [Services Catalog](https://www.ghbooster.com/services.html): Complete catalog of social media marketing services with live real-time pricing per 1,000 units, minimum/maximum order bounds, and refill policies.
- [API Documentation](https://www.ghbooster.com/api.html): Comprehensive API v2 reference for resellers, developers, and panel owners to automate orders via REST API.
- [Blog & Guides](https://www.ghbooster.com/blog.html): Comprehensive social media marketing guides, algorithm breakdowns, and boosting strategies.
- [FAQ](https://www.ghbooster.com/faq.html): Frequently asked questions regarding order processing, automated delivery timelines, refill guarantees, and accepted payment methods.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.ghbooster.com/terms.html): Terms and conditions, privacy policies, refund policies, and usage guidelines.

## User Account & Dashboard

- [Login](https://www.ghbooster.com/login): Secure user portal login page.
- [Register](https://www.ghbooster.com/register): User account registration form to create a new GhBooster account.
- [Dashboard](https://www.ghbooster.com/dashboard): Main user dashboard for placing new single orders, tracking active order status, and reviewing account metrics.
- [Bulk Order](https://www.ghbooster.com/bulk-order): Bulk order interface for submitting multiple service requests simultaneously line-by-line.
- [Orders History](https://www.ghbooster.com/orders): Order management page displaying order history, status (Pending, Processing, Completed, Partial, Canceled), and start/remains counts.
- [Add Funds](https://www.ghbooster.com/add-funds): Payment gateway portal supporting automated deposit methods including Mobile Money (MTN, Telecel, AT), Cryptocurrencies, Paystack, Flutterwave, and credit cards.
- [Transactions](https://www.ghbooster.com/transactions): Financial history listing all deposits, balance adjustments, and order debits.
- [Support Tickets](https://www.ghbooster.com/tickets): Customer support portal for opening and tracking support tickets.
- [Affiliates & Referrals](https://www.ghbooster.com/referrals): Referral program dashboard allowing users to earn commission by inviting new clients.
- [Child Panel](https://www.ghbooster.com/child-panel): Rental platform for users to launch their own branded SMM reseller panel connected to GhBooster API.
- [Account Settings](https://www.ghbooster.com/account): Profile management, API key generation, and password update page.

## Key Features & Capabilities

- **Instant Automated Delivery**: 24/7 automated order processing connected directly to high-capacity provider nodes.
- **API v2 Integration**: Full compatibility with standard SMM panel API format (actions: `services`, `add`, `status`, `balance`).
- **Multi-Platform Support**: SMM services covering Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Telegram, Facebook, X (Twitter), Spotify, and Twitch.
- **Reseller Friendly**: High throughput endpoints, bulk order execution, and automated child panel setup.
